reading.title: Choosing Colours for a Display
reading.text: A shop manager and a designer are preparing a window display. They compare red, blue, yellow, green, black, and white items, then add orange and pink details for contrast. reading.text: At a paint counter, an adult customer compares several colour samples for a home office. One green is light, another is dark, and a blue sample looks pale beside a vivid turquoise. reading.title: Preparing a Colour Sample
reading.text: A junior designer prepares a colour sample for a poster. She mixes two pigments, then blends them until the hue looks even. Next, she adjusts the tint and saturation and checks the gradient on screen. Before sending the file, she compares the final colours with a printed spectrum to make sure the result is consistent.
